items.title: MECH-322 replay-origin corroboration survival under realistic conditions
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from confidence scoring). Follow-on to the CONFIRMED failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-873a_2026-08-07 (routed onward, NEW EXQ number, NOT a lettered 873b -- 873a's AND-gate question is answered). Question: does a replay-origin-tagged chunk, minted under valid conditions, ever get CORROBORATED by real waking execution before its dissolution deadline expires under REALISTIC (not artificially accelerated) conditions? 873a measured only the accelerated regime (N=15, checkpoint ep 90/120) and saw 7/7 dissolve. Design: 3 arms differ ONLY in the corroboration deadline N (chunk_replay_corroboration_episodes) -- ARM_DEADLINE_15 (873a accelerated replication), ARM_DEADLINE_75 (substrate DEFAULT = realistic), ARM_DEADLINE_200 (deadline beyond the 120-ep run -> deadline-independent recurrence/exposure measure); all mint identically at an EARLY checkpoint (ep 20 -> 100 post-mint waking episodes). Corroboration is emergent (FORMING replay chunk is not selectable) via trailing-match re-execution. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (corroboration/survival fraction under realistic N + early checkpoint) recorded in NO manifest -- only 873/873a flipped the flag, both accelerated-regime; not derivable from an accelerated manifest -> run. Re-derive brake: 0 MECH-322 substrate_ceiling autopsies -> not braked. DV-SYMMETRY: each arm's survival DV is a deadline-gated step function of N (not invariant under any additive/monotone/permutation symmetry); corroboration TIMING is N-independent per seed, which is what isolates the deadline. Both directions valid: a positive reading strengthens the MECH-322 lifecycle characterisation; a null reading shows the accelerated-dissolution safety valve firing as designed and does NOT weaken MECH-322. Smoke PASS (dry-run: mint fired all arms, deadline responded to N -- N=15/75 arms dissolved-by-deadline in the toy window, N>=100 arm survived). validate_experiments --strict OK.

items.title: MECH-074d BLA PE-remap attribution selectivity (wall-independent representation DV)
items.note: GOV-CONFIRM-1 confirming DV routed from IGW workset item IGW-20260807-235. MECH-074d has a BUILT substrate (SD-035 BLAAnalog, IMPLEMENTED 2026-04-21), literature_confidence 0.809 over 4 lit entries, and genuine_exp_count 0 -- its only prior tagged run, V3-EXQ-474, is a module-boundary substrate-readiness diagnostic driven by SYNTHETIC PE spikes and hand-supplied candidate dicts, never a live agent. RENUMBERED FROM V3-EXQ-893: a concurrent session landed a different v3_exq_893_mech232_da_representational_expansion_confirmer.py on origin/main at 2026-08-08T00:18Z, 13 min before this work's script commit. Safe to renumber because this entry had no coordinator DB row (see the queue-writer note below). WALL-INDEPENDENT BY CONSTRUCTION: every readout is internal to the ContextMemory store the remap writes to (per-slot displacement, off-diagonal pairwise-cosine spread, retention) plus the composition of the gate's own target sets; no behavioural outcome is read, so no wall can gate the result. No substrate_not_ready_requeue was needed at design time -- a representation DV IS designable -- but the script self-routes to that label if ARM_REMAP_ON's readiness gate comes back red. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is per-slot ContextMemory displacement/differentiation split by remap-target status against a matched remap-disabled control. Absent from every manifest; reanalysis_query found no MECH-074d readout, and the only ContextMemory manifest in the corpus (v3_exq_477 SD-016 slot-store diagnostic, 2026-04-24) carries no BLA remap manipulation and predates the recording standard so has no substrate_hash (UNVERIFIABLE -> not recoverable) -> run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: 0 counted substrate_ceiling autopsies on MECH-074d -> not braked. SUBSTRATE-PATH OVERLAP GATE: no open substrate_queue entry declares substrate_paths at all, so no corrupting/degrading overlap. SUBSTRATE PROBE FINDING THAT SHAPED THE DESIGN (2026-08-08): use_e2_harm_a=True is LOAD-BEARING and is NOT set by the sibling V3-EXQ-888 config -- without it _harm_a_pred_prev stays None (agent.py:8594), bla.tick gets z_harm_a_pred=None and remap_signal can NEVER fire (0 fires / 296 ticks measured). With it, 72 fires / 137 ticks. Set identically in BOTH arms. DESIGN: 2 arms x 3 seeds [42,43,45] (44 excluded per the standing reef-config early-death instability). ARM_REMAP_ON bla_remap_pe_sigma_threshold=1.0 (SD-035 default) vs ARM_REMAP_OFF 1e9 (gate can never open). Remap is held SHUT in BOTH arms through P0 so neither enters the measurement window with a pre-degraded store, and the measurement window RESTORES ContextMemory to the end-of-P0 snapshot at the start of EVERY episode in both arms -- forced by the smoke, which showed the open gate fires on ~93% of ticks and drives slot differentiation 0.0892 -> 4.9e-07 WITHIN ONE EPISODE. Without the restore, C1/C2 would measure a degeneracy the remap inflicted on itself and report it as a property of the attribution gate (verdict aliasing). A bla_remap_requires_attribution=False broadcast arm was considered and DELIBERATELY OMITTED: reading bla.py:504-531, with candidates present (and the agent always supplies them, since the softmax puts positive mass on every slot) that path is bit-identical to the default -- it would be an inert arm, not a third condition. DV-SYMMETRY (one per arm). DV group = {per-slot cm.memory content, summarised as displacement and as the spread of off-diagonal pairwise cosine similarity} + {index composition of the target sets}; these are invariant under a permutation of slots and under any transform applied identically to all slots. ARM_REMAP_ON: the manipulation is an in-place blend of a SELECTED MINORITY of slots toward a common write_signal -- neither a permutation nor a uniform-over-all-slots transform, and a blend of a strict subset toward a common vector strictly contracts pairwise distances among the written slots, so it CANNOT cancel in the spread statistic (unlike a broadcast constant, which would cancel in a range). Confirmed live: exactly 5 of 16 slots displaced per event. ARM_REMAP_OFF: the manipulation is the ABSENCE of that write; the DV registers presence-vs-absence directly (smoke: spread preserved 0.0892 with the gate shut, collapsed 4.9e-07 with it open). Neither arm's manipulation is invariant under its DV. CRITERIA (pre-registered constants; PASS iff C1 AND C2 AND C3 AND C4, each on >=2/3 seeds -- a plain AND, recorded as combination_rule). C1 [load-bearing] attribution selectivity: mean mass on the k selected candidates minus the k/n chance floor > 0.05. C2 [load-bearing] context-differentiated addressing: mean within-context minus mean cross-context target-set Jaccard > 0.05 -- the Moita 2004 contextual-vs-auditory dissociation transposed; deliberately NOT a bare Jaccard, which aliases perfect addressing with a constant degenerate target set (1.0 either way) whereas the gap gives 0 for the degenerate case. C3 [load-bearing] partial-not-wholesale: ON mean end-of-episode slot differentiation >= 0.5x the matched OFF value at the same seed. C4 pe-spike sparsity: fire fraction <= 0.25, pre-registered from normal theory (a >1-SD excursion is ~0.16 of ticks), NOT tuned to the probe's ~0.5. READINESS IS NOT CIRCULAR: the gate asserts the INPUTS (baseline slot differentiation, PE spread, fire count, both contexts represented), strictly upstream of C1, so uniform attribution on a DIFFERENTIATED store is a falsification of the claim rather than a starved criterion. Fire-dependent preconditions are scoped OUT of the gate-shut arm via applies_to/structural_max (the V3-EXQ-785 rule) and do not vacate the live arm. Smoke (1 seed) PASS: all 7 engagement checks green including episode_restore_effective; validate_experiments --strict OK; validate_recording --strict complete. OPERATOR ACTION REQUIRED -- STEP 8.6 NOT PERFORMED: this entry was queued from a headless cloud worker (ree-cloud-5) that has no REE_assembly/coordinator.env, so POST /queue/add could not be issued. An identical git-only add under the previous id V3-EXQ-893 was ERASED within ~1 minute by the phase3-queue snapshot writer (origin commit a37c90af re-materialised the queue from the DB). Unless sync_daemon's reconcile ingests this commit before the next snapshot tick, this entry will disappear the same way. From the Mac: POST this item to ${COORDINATOR_URL}/queue/add and confirm it appears in /queue/active. The SCRIPT is durably on origin/main either way.

items.title: MECH-074c CeA fast_prime dynamics: onset latency, decay tau, overridable window
items.note: GOV-CONFIRM-1 evidence confirmer for IGW workset item IGW-20260807-240 (stable_hash 133da2eb256a). MECH-074c has literature_confidence ~0.75 and ZERO indexed EVIDENCE-class experiment despite built+IMPLEMENTED substrate (SD-035, ree_core/amygdala/cea.py). WALL-INDEPENDENT: the gated DVs are functional-signature / timing readouts on the fast_prime scalar the real CeAAnalog emits, read out action-free (no policy, no training, no behavioural outcome), so they are immune to the competence wall. Structural sibling of V3-EXQ-762, which confirmed MECH-046 on this same substrate the same way. DVs: C1 onset latency <= 2 sim steps from threshold crossing; C2 fitted fast_prime half-life in [3,5] steps under cortical non-confirmation; C3 retained fraction at override-window end <= 0.50; C4 confirmation holds the pulse (>= 0.90 retained) with arm separation >= 0.40 on BIT-IDENTICAL drive; C5 max |fast_prime| <= mode_prior_log_odds_max. PASS = plain AND of all five (all load-bearing). PARTIAL BY DESIGN: MECH-074c's falsifier names three legs; this run gates legs 1 and 2 and does NOT gate leg 3 (selectivity vs arousing-but-neutral). Leg 3 is NOT designable as a CeA-module manipulation -- CeAAnalog.tick() is a pure function of ||z_harm_a||_1/n, so a magnitude-matched non-harm drive fires IDENTICALLY by arithmetic and a mismatched one is decided by magnitude alone; either way the delta is fixed before the run (the DV-symmetry artifact class, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-604c s3). Selectivity is an upstream AffectiveHarmEncoder property. It is therefore MEASURED AND RECORDED as a NON-GATING block that self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue, deliberately kept out of interpretation.preconditions[] so it cannot vacate the two clean gated legs (the V3-EXQ-785 whole-run-AND defect). Smoke confirms that self-route fires: 0 embodied fast-route fires, max ||z_harm_a||_1/n 0.202 vs threshold 0.5. DV-SYMMETRY DECLARATION (per arm): C1's DV (onset latency in ticks) has symmetry group = temporal translation of the drive onset, and the manipulation (a step change in drive magnitude at a designated tick) is NOT invariant under it -- translating the onset translates the latency 1:1. C2/C3's DVs (fitted half-life, retained fraction) are RATIOS, symmetry group = uniform positive rescaling of fast_prime; the manipulation (withholding confirmation) changes the decay RATE not the scale, so it is not invariant, and the DVs' scale-invariance is why randomised peak magnitudes cannot manufacture the result. C4's DV (retained fraction) has symmetry group = uniform rescaling and tick permutation; cortical_confirmation 0 vs 1 is a temporal-order-dependent change to the decay recursion (cea.py:396-415), invariant under neither -- verified numerically pre-authoring (0.297 vs 1.000 on identical drive). C5's sweep records whether the UNCLIPPED value exceeded the cap, so a vacuous bound-pass is visible. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readouts sought were fast_prime onset latency, fitted decay half-life, and a selectivity contrast. Checked v3_exq_473_sd035_cea_mode_prior (the only prior run tagging MECH-074c; run_ids ..._20260421T195334Z_v3 and ..._20260421T195533Z_v3) -- experiment_purpose=diagnostic (which is WHY MECH-074c scores exp_conf 0.0) with substrate_hash None (compatibility unverifiable). It recorded no latency, no fitted tau and no selectivity probe: only a single fire point (fast_prime 0.2999 at |z_harm_a|=0.9) and a 2-point decay/hold pair, with no per-tick trace to derive from. Not recoverable -> run. Re-derive brake: 0 braking autopsies on MECH-074c. Substrate-path overlap gate: 0 open substrate_queue entries with substrate_paths. SUBSTRATE WIRING NOTE (found while authoring, worth knowing for any CeA/BLA work): agent.act()/sense_flat() pass obs_harm_a=None, so z_harm_a is never produced and the CeA never ticks on that path. Verified live: 0/480 ticks produced a CeAOutput via agent.act(), 480/480 via the canonical StepHarness (which supplies obs_harm_a from the env obs_dict). The selectivity block therefore drives the agent through StepHarness. Out of scope, named not silently omitted: the functional_restatement's fast:slow ratio (~5:1 vs the cortical AIC/dACC comparator) needs SD-032c wiring on the same tick base -- a successor. Smoke PASS (2-seed dry-run, 220s): all 5 criteria pass and all 5 non-degenerate flags true (C5's clip region genuinely reached, unclipped 1.5 > cap 0.8); all 4 readiness preconditions met with recomputable measured/threshold; arms bit-identical (P3 measured 0.0); validate_experiments --strict OK on all 23 checks; validate_recording --strict complete.
